decisions.reason: As a visible offering carried on its own page for two years and closely tied to customer support for the installed machine base, management is likely to continue it despite limited direct returns.
Although public commitment was modest, the accessory fits the core machining business and can still be justified as a complementary option for existing customers.
This looks like a more experimental and less visibly committed extension beyond the firm’s core, so disappointing traction would be easier for management to abandon.
A high-speed CNC milling machine represents a major, highly visible and core investment, making management strongly inclined to persist and explain weak results as temporary.
The automatic tool change system was publicly presented as a standalone product and is central to machining performance, so prior investment and strategic fit favor continuation.
